## About
Michael Auto Clinic is a car repair and maintenance shop on Harlem Ave in Morton Grove. We look at every car as if it were our own and give you an honest read on what it needs.
From oil and full maintenance to suspension, electric and fuel system problems, we handle the work ourselves. Customers tell us they appreciate the personal attention and the tips on long-term maintenance, and several thank Mikhail and Nelya by name.
We have a 5 star rating from 620 Google reviews, and many of those reviews come from people who keep coming back with every car in the family.

## Services
- Oil and full scale maintenance: Fresh oil and a full maintenance check to keep your car running well.
- Suspension or electric repairs: Diagnosis and repair for suspension and electric problems.
- Starter and water pump: Customers have had a starter, water pump, valve cover gasket and variable valve solenoid replaced here.
- Catalytic converter: One customer's catalytic converter was cleaned, saving them hundreds of dollars.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Customers bring us everything from Mercedes and BMW to a Passat and whole fleets of Fords.

Q: Will you work on an older car?
A: Yes. One customer started bringing us their 13 year old Honda and has been happy with the results.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: We are open Saturday mornings until early afternoon and closed on Sunday.
